title: Commit deposit deduplication and invoice transitions atomically
description:
## Description

runtime.ts inserts Payment, updates invoice totals, changes completion and appends events separately. Crash after payment insertion makes replay skip missing totals/events. In-memory hash sets cannot enforce durable correctness.

## Steps to Reproduce

Inject failure after paymentStore.create and before invoiceStore.update. Replay the same confirmed source hash after restart; existingPayment prevents the invoice total and events from being repaired. Repeat after each transition write.

## Acceptance Criteria

Use a transaction spanning unique deposit identity, invoice matching/amount/status, event append and receive-job intent. Injected failures roll back the entire transition. Concurrent/restarted replay converges on one payment contribution and one completion transition. Remove silent adapter fallback from the transactional path.
acceptance_criteria: Use a transaction spanning unique deposit identity, invoice matching/amount/status, event append and receive-job intent. Injected failures roll back the entire transition. Concurrent/restarted replay converges on one payment contribution and one completion transition. Remove silent adapter fallback from the transactional path.

title: Persist exact send blocks before broadcast and recover ambiguous outcomes
description:
## Description

send-orchestrator.ts reads fresh accountInfo, signs and publishes before saving blockHash/status. Crash after node acceptance leaves a queued send that rebuilds against the advanced frontier and transfers again. Old block handling cannot deduplicate a different block. Broad catches can mark accepted transfers failed after storage/event errors.

## Steps to Reproduce

Queue one send; let the fake node accept process, then terminate before sendStore.update. Restart against node state whose frontier includes that send. The queued operation signs another block debiting the same amount. Also inject a persistence/event failure after process to observe an accepted transfer marked failed.

## Acceptance Criteria

Persist the exact signed block and expected hash before process. Restart and timeout reconcile or rebroadcast that same intent without rebuilding another transfer. Recover queued and published sends. An unknown network outcome is not a terminal failed transfer. Concurrent idempotency-key retries return one operation; changed payload under the same key conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: Persist the exact signed block and expected hash before process. Restart and timeout reconcile or rebroadcast that same intent without rebuilding another transfer. Recover queued and published sends. An unknown network outcome is not a terminal failed transfer. Concurrent idempotency-key retries return one operation; changed payload under the same key conflicts.

title: Separate confirmed deposits from recipient balance and frontier updates
description:
## Description

AccountStateSync.handleConfirmedBlock increments recipient balance and assigns the incoming send hash as frontier, then Runtime.ingestConfirmedBlock repeats both mutations before persistent payment deduplication. Incoming send hashes belong to the sender chain; spendable recipient state changes on its own receive/open block. A restart can replay the balance mutation.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run default main.ts sink wiring with a managed recipient at balance 0. Deliver one confirmed incoming send for amount A through AccountStateSync. It increments to A and sets the sender hash as recipient frontier, then forwards to Runtime which increments to 2A. Restart and replay to expose the missing durable account guard.

## Acceptance Criteria

One owner updates recipient chain projections from verified account/receive state. A confirmed incoming send creates one deposit/receivable without advancing recipient frontier or double-incrementing balance. Repeated delivery and restart replay leave balances unchanged; reconciliation cannot double-credit. Cover default main.ts wiring, not only each class in isolation.
acceptance_criteria: One owner updates recipient chain projections from verified account/receive state. A confirmed incoming send creates one deposit/receivable without advancing recipient frontier or double-incrementing balance. Repeated delivery and restart replay leave balances unchanged; reconciliation cannot double-credit. Cover default main.ts wiring, not only each class in isolation.
close_reason: Recipient chain projections now come only from account_info reconciliation; confirmed sends no longer mutate recipient balance/frontier, with duplicate and restart replay coverage through the default forwarding path.

title: Exercise recovery and commerce scenarios through the public runtime interface
description:
## Description

The review found cross-module failures that isolated mocked tests do not capture. A bounded public-interface suite should prove the intended guarantees rather than mirror implementation details.

## Acceptance Criteria

Cover crash after node acceptance before local completion, duplicate requests/events across restarts, concurrent send/receive, deposit during notification outage that is received before recovery, webhook outage/restart, two simultaneous customer orders, partial/late/excess payments and sweep recovery. Use controlled fake-node faults or local devnet; never real funds or arbitrary public RPC availability.
acceptance_criteria: Cover crash after node acceptance before local completion, duplicate requests/events across restarts, concurrent send/receive, deposit during notification outage that is received before recovery, webhook outage/restart, two simultaneous customer orders, partial/late/excess payments and sweep recovery. Use controlled fake-node faults or local devnet; never real funds or arbitrary public RPC availability.

title: Rebuild checkout, customer deposit/withdrawal and watched-payment examples
description:
## Description

Current SDK docs and examples still use obsolete /api requests, caller-supplied invoice recipients and optional keys. Validate the product by integrations matching typical commerce, not tile/game transactions.

## Acceptance Criteria

Three small examples use only supported SDK calls: any-wallet external checkout, stable customer deposit plus custodial withdrawal, and watched-address payment observation. No client PoW/frontier/receive/watcher management on the ordinary path. Show idempotency, durable event consumption and late/excess handling; keep wallet keys out of browser checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Three small examples use only supported SDK calls: any-wallet external checkout, stable customer deposit plus custodial withdrawal, and watched-address payment observation. No client PoW/frontier/receive/watcher management on the ordinary path. Show idempotency, durable event consumption and late/excess handling; keep wallet keys out of browser checkout.

title: Converge the public SDK on invoices, accounts, sends and durable events
description:
## Description

Parallel InvoiceAccounts/Subaccounts/Receives concepts and ephemeral account streams expose housekeeping rather than commerce outcomes. InvoiceAccounts aggregated balance sums historical receipts and open expectations, not spendable funds. Keep established pre-signed support only as an advanced path.

## Acceptance Criteria

Give each public resource one clear business meaning; remove misleading balance views and duplicate lookup methods where superseded. Stable customer deposits and invoices use explicit references with safe defaults. Durable replayable business events cover the normal path. Resolve duplicate ephemeral stream machinery deliberately; no compatibility shims or new allocation/receive bypasses.
acceptance_criteria: Give each public resource one clear business meaning; remove misleading balance views and duplicate lookup methods where superseded. Stable customer deposits and invoices use explicit references with safe defaults. Durable replayable business events cover the normal path. Resolve duplicate ephemeral stream machinery deliberately; no compatibility shims or new allocation/receive bypasses.

title: Route all internal work through one injected WorkProvider
description:
## Description

Custody spawns native local work per search; RPC work directly calls nano-rspow. Configured nano.work endpoints do not feed custody. nano-core already owns WorkProvider/PowEngine routing, threshold resolution and validation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Wire configured remote endpoints and explicit local fallback through one internal provider shared by operation types. Keep blocking native searches isolated and validate returned nonces against actual root/threshold. Use canonical contract difficulty vocabulary. Application invoice/account/send callers never manage work or routing.
acceptance_criteria: Wire configured remote endpoints and explicit local fallback through one internal provider shared by operation types. Keep blocking native searches isolated and validate returned nonces against actual root/threshold. Use canonical contract difficulty vocabulary. Application invoice/account/send callers never manage work or routing.

title: Align HTTP and SDK amount validation with exact serialization
description:
## Description

CreateInvoiceOptions accepts expectedAmount while handler requires expectedAmountRaw. Invoice boundary validation does not enforce complete numeric/range/policy rules. ORIS-012 describes exact raw and XNO encoding.

## Steps to Reproduce

Call the public SDK invoices.create with expectedAmount only; its declared type permits this, while the handler returns missing expectedAmountRaw. Submit malformed/out-of-range raw strings to expose the missing shared validation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Use one request schema across SDK and HTTP with explicit amount units and exact conversion via nano-core. Accept one coherent representation or reject inconsistent alternatives. Reject numeric raw, fractional JSON-number XNO, negatives, malformed values, overflow beyond uint128 and invalid completion policies. Align metadata types and structured errors.
acceptance_criteria: Use one request schema across SDK and HTTP with explicit amount units and exact conversion via nano-core. Accept one coherent representation or reject inconsistent alternatives. Reject numeric raw, fractional JSON-number XNO, negatives, malformed values, overflow beyond uint128 and invalid completion policies. Align metadata types and structured errors.

title: Recover missed confirmations with persistent discovery and acknowledged subscriptions
description:
## Description

Watcher currently selects WebSocket OR pending polling. WebSocket reconnect has no historical catch-up; receivables alone miss already-received payments. Poller marks hashes seen before sink success, subscriptions lack acknowledgements/account filters and deduplication is mostly in memory.

## Steps to Reproduce

Drop WebSocket connectivity, send to a watched destination and receive the funds before reconnect. Receivable-only discovery cannot recover it. Reject a poller sink once and observe seenHashes already suppressing that send for the process lifetime.

## Acceptance Criteria

Discover missed sends through receivables plus bounded account-history reconciliation, then validate finality before the shared atomic ingest path. Persist cursors/deduplication and advance only after successful ingestion. Reconnect/outage recovers already-received payments. Account-filtered subscriptions request/verify ack; no global ledger index is required.
acceptance_criteria: Discover missed sends through receivables plus bounded account-history reconciliation, then validate finality before the shared atomic ingest path. Persist cursors/deduplication and advance only after successful ingestion. Reconnect/outage recovers already-received payments. Account-filtered subscriptions request/verify ack; no global ledger index is required.

title: Settle received invoice funds through the normal durable send pipeline
description:
## Description

Config exposes autoSweep and sweepDestination and the model declares invoice.swept, but invoice completion has no wired sweep pipeline. Invoice derivation addresses are outside the managed account send path.

## Acceptance Criteria

Configured settlement queues one recoverable sweep after owned funds are spendable, using the shared account executor and persisted exact-block intent. Record sweep state and emit invoice.swept only at the documented successful stage. Repeated completion, crashes and insufficient-yet-unreceived balance cannot duplicate or lose settlement. Disabled autoSweep performs no treasury transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Configured settlement queues one recoverable sweep after owned funds are spendable, using the shared account executor and persisted exact-block intent. Record sweep state and emit invoice.swept only at the documented successful stage. Repeated completion, crashes and insufficient-yet-unreceived balance cannot duplicate or lose settlement. Disabled autoSweep performs no treasury transfer.

title: Apply configured invoice expiry and deterministic lifecycle transitions
description:
## Description

Config accepts defaultExpirySeconds but runtime does not apply it during invoice creation. Expiry currently races independently with matching.

## Steps to Reproduce

Set invoices.defaultExpirySeconds, create an invoice without expiresAt, and inspect persistence; no configured expiry is applied. Race expiry/cancel and confirmed payment ingestion to expose separate non-atomic transitions.

## Acceptance Criteria

Absent explicit expiry uses the configured default; explicit dates are validated. Atomic lifecycle rules define payment/expiry and cancellation races. Completed invoices never reopen. Expired invoices stop fulfillment while preserving late-payment recording.
acceptance_criteria: Absent explicit expiry uses the configured default; explicit dates are validated. Atomic lifecycle rules define payment/expiry and cancellation races. Completed invoices never reopen. Expired invoices stop fulfillment while preserving late-payment recording.

title: Handle late, excess, partial and unmatched payments without misfulfillment
description:
## Description

ORIS-008 section 5 describes core commerce lifecycle cases. The current matcher only considers open invoices; terminal invoices and unmatched transfers have no durable resolution path.

## Acceptance Criteria

Persist and expose partial totals, overpayment excess, repeated transfers, late payments and unmatched deposits with clear disposition. Retain destination observation after expiry/completion as needed. Only the intended eligible invoice completes once; late funds never pay a newer unrelated order. Use confirmed sends as payment evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Persist and expose partial totals, overpayment excess, repeated transfers, late payments and unmatched deposits with clear disposition. Retain destination observation after expiry/completion as needed. Only the intended eligible invoice completes once; late funds never pay a newer unrelated order. Use confirmed sends as payment evidence.

title: Persist webhook attempts and restore retries after restart
description:
## Description

delivery.ts stores retry timers in memory although webhook_deliveries exists. Restart loses deliveries, and delivery filtering accepts only exact names or * while RFC examples use invoice.*.

## Steps to Reproduce

Configure an endpoint that returns HTTP 503. Emit an event, terminate while retry timers are pending, and restart; no persisted attempt resumes delivery. Subscribe to invoice.* and observe the exact-only engine filter.

## Acceptance Criteria

Drive delivery from persisted outbox/attempts. Restore scheduled retries after restart, record response/terminal failure, bound concurrency and timeouts, and support documented namespace filters. Receiver outage does not delay invoice creation or interrupt committed payment processing. Duplicate deliveries retain the same event ID.
acceptance_criteria: Drive delivery from persisted outbox/attempts. Restore scheduled retries after restart, record response/terminal failure, bound concurrency and timeouts, and support documented namespace filters. Receiver outage does not delay invoice creation or interrupt committed payment processing. Duplicate deliveries retain the same event ID.

title: Give one-time invoices distinct destinations and reusable deposits explicit semantics
description:
## Description

invoiceKey is optional, so invoices sharing accountKey and null invoiceKey reuse an address. FIFO matching can attribute a late payment to the next open order. Invoice addresses and managed accounts also have overlapping conceptual responsibilities.

## Steps to Reproduce

Create two invoices for the same accountKey without invoiceKey. Observe identical destinations and FIFO attribution. Expire the old order, create a new one, then deliver a payment intended for the old order; it is matched to the newer open invoice.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every one-time invoice has an unambiguous persisted payment target by default, including two simultaneous orders for one customer. Explicit application references are separate from derivation internals. Reusable customer deposits remain an explicit account use case. Replace the bounded 27-bit hash allocation/collision failure with a deliberate persisted allocation policy; no compatibility constraint requires preserving the old public request shape.
acceptance_criteria: Every one-time invoice has an unambiguous persisted payment target by default, including two simultaneous orders for one customer. Explicit application references are separate from derivation internals. Reusable customer deposits remain an explicit account use case. Replace the bounded 27-bit hash allocation/collision failure with a deliberate persisted allocation policy; no compatibility constraint requires preserving the old public request shape.

title: Create a transactional outbox for durable business side effects
description:
## Description

Persist-first events alone do not bridge state changes to webhook delivery. Runtime currently performs HTTP delivery inline and durable delivery intent is absent.

## Acceptance Criteria

Commit side-effect intent with domain events. Workers claim and recover delivery jobs without blocking invoice/payment transitions on HTTP. Stable event IDs and monotonic cursors support replay and at-least-once consumption. Preserve self-contained canonical event payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Commit side-effect intent with domain events. Workers claim and recover delivery jobs without blocking invoice/payment transitions on HTTP. Stable event IDs and monotonic cursors support replay and at-least-once consumption. Preserve self-contained canonical event payloads.

title: Persist confirmed deposits independently of invoice matching
description:
## Description

Canonical Payment requires invoiceId and the matcher persists only transfers to open invoices. Reusable customer deposit accounts, unknown deposits and late payments need durable records too. A realtime AccountEvent is not a durable deposit history.

## Acceptance Criteria

Persist each confirmed incoming send by unique source block hash with destination, amount, source, confirmation time and optional invoice association. Provide queryable customer/account deposit history. Sender identity is not assumed to identify a customer. Ignore own receive/change blocks for crediting; do not turn RaiFlow into the application's customer ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Persist each confirmed incoming send by unique source block hash with destination, amount, source, confirmation time and optional invoice association. Provide queryable customer/account deposit history. Sender identity is not assumed to identify a customer. Ignore own receive/change blocks for crediting; do not turn RaiFlow into the application's customer ledger.

title: Recover receive jobs independently of API reads
description:
## Description

Receive jobs move to processing and are then excluded from pending scans after a crash. Exact receive blocks are not persisted before publishing. Invoice ingestion looks up derivation from open invoices after completion, so a successful payment can lose its receive enqueue trigger. GET handlers currently provide housekeeping recovery.

## Steps to Reproduce

Terminate after marking a receive task processing and restart; pending-only selection never resumes it. Separately complete an invoice with a confirmed send before receivables are enqueued, then perform no GET requests; the open-invoice derivation lookup no longer finds the account.

## Acceptance Criteria

Enqueue receiving as part of deposit ingestion and recover expired processing leases. Persist/reconcile receive block identity before broadcast. Completing/canceling/expiring an invoice does not lose owned receivables. A payment is received without subsequent GET requests or manual receives API; source-send finality remains distinct from receive-block finality.
acceptance_criteria: Enqueue receiving as part of deposit ingestion and recover expired processing leases. Persist/reconcile receive block identity before broadcast. Completing/canceling/expiring an invoice does not lose owned receivables. A payment is received without subsequent GET requests or manual receives API; source-send finality remains distinct from receive-block finality.

title: Serialize account-chain operations with durable leases
description:
## Description

SendOrchestrator and ReceiveOrchestrator process independently and can construct competing blocks against the same frontier. One internal operation executor should own account-chain writes; do not expose locks, leases or receiving controls in the public API.

## Acceptance Criteria

Persist operation leases with expiration/recovery. Sends, receives, sweeps and representative changes share per-account serialization while unrelated accounts can progress. Recover abandoned operations without a second executor issuing the same step. Keep SQLite as the default.
acceptance_criteria: Persist operation leases with expiration/recovery. Sends, receives, sweeps and representative changes share per-account serialization while unrelated accounts can progress. Recover abandoned operations without a second executor issuing the same step. Keep SQLite as the default.

title: Remove tile-matrix allocation and manual receive controls from runtime and SDK
description:
## Description

Commits d105a6a and 7a02a98 introduced SubaccountsResource, ReceivesResource and POST /v1/subaccounts/allocate plus /v1/receives/batch. Tests use game namespaces and tile coordinates. Existing local work extends them with watch:false and allocation-stage diagnostics. These controls expose internal housekeeping to a game-specific caller. Preserve unrelated uncommitted work and the receive worker.

## Acceptance Criteria

Remove both SDK resources, exports, routes and dead Runtime helpers, including deferred-watcher/allocator diagnostics. Remove obsolete route tests and supersede the pending changeset. Document removal and retain generic account creation, watched accounts, sends, invoice processing, receiving internals and established events/block support.
acceptance_criteria: Remove both SDK resources, exports, routes and dead Runtime helpers, including deferred-watcher/allocator diagnostics. Remove obsolete route tests and supersede the pending changeset. Document removal and retain generic account creation, watched accounts, sends, invoice processing, receiving internals and established events/block support.
close_reason: Removed SubaccountsResource and ReceivesResource, both runtime routes, queueReceives, deferred watcher/allocation diagnostics and obsolete game-route tests. Recorded removal and commerce scope in RFC 0001, replaced deferred-subaccount changeset with a breaking API removal changeset, and reduced progress to current context. pnpm build passed; full pnpm test passed under actual Node 22.23.2. Initial Node 26 run exposed a local SQLite ABI mismatch, resolved by using the project Node version without dependency changes.

title: Keep RaiFlow focused on commerce and retire Nanosweeper-specific controls
description:
## Decision

Focus RaiFlow on external-wallet checkout, reusable customer deposits and custodial withdrawals behind invoices, accounts, sends and durable business events. Remove the Nanosweeper tile-matrix allocator, manual receive batching and deferred watcher activation. No compatibility aliases are required: the user confirmed no known commercial consumers and explicitly authorized breaking refactoring on 2026-10-20.

## Rationale

Game tile namespaces and browser-wallet transaction choreography expose internal receiving and observation responsibilities to application callers. The intended commerce happy path delegates those mechanics to the runtime. Protocol primitives remain in nano-core, key isolation in OWS and work engines in nano-rspow. Generic watched accounts, durable business events and established pre-signed-block support have independent use cases.

## Alternatives Considered

Retain the game-specific APIs as compatibility shims: rejected because they preserve the design drift and no commercial user requires them. Remove all watched accounts, streaming and pre-signed flows: rejected because the accepted design includes legitimate independent uses. Make x402, SIWN, NOMS or NanoNyms mandatory: rejected because ordinary checkout must work with external wallets without new signing or identity capabilities.

## Acceptance Criteria

Record this scope in RFC 0001 and progress. Mark the tile matrix allocator, manual receive batching and deferred watcher controls obsolete; do not introduce compatibility aliases. The repair epic captures remaining implementation work.
acceptance_criteria: Record this scope in RFC 0001 and progress. Mark the tile matrix allocator, manual receive batching and deferred watcher controls obsolete; do not introduce compatibility aliases. Do not make x402, SIWN, NOMS or NanoNyms prerequisites for checkout.
close_reason: Recorded user-approved commerce scope, obsolete game-specific APIs, and lack of compatibility constraints in RFC 0001 and progress.

title: Restore RaiFlow commerce reliability and a small high-level API
description:
## Description

Restore the accepted two-domain runtime: invoices and customer deposits, managed or watched accounts, durable sends, persisted events and webhooks. Source review on 2026-10-20 found incorrect account projections, ambiguous send replay, non-atomic payment processing and incomplete commerce lifecycles. No known commercial consumers; backwards compatibility does not constrain the repair. Nanosweeper tile matrices and client-wallet transaction controls are not product requirements. Each child is independently reviewable and carries its own acceptance criteria; dependencies express actual prerequisites rather than a blanket serial queue.

## Success Criteria

Typical external-wallet checkout, reusable customer deposits and custodial withdrawals work through a small SDK without application-managed PoW, frontiers, receiving or watcher activation. Recovery and duplicate delivery preserve money and business state. Scope and upstream ownership are documented.
acceptance_criteria: Typical external-wallet checkout, reusable customer deposits and custodial withdrawals work through a small SDK without application-managed PoW, frontiers, receiving or watcher activation. Recovery and duplicate delivery preserve money and business state. Scope and upstream ownership are documented.
notes: Planning and initial scope cleanup completed 2026-10-20. All 26 child issues have types, priorities and acceptance criteria; bug items include reproduction scenarios and dependencies form an acyclic graph. Scope decision .1 and cleanup .2 are complete; the substantive accounting/recovery/lifecycle repairs remain open. Existing unrelated dirty work is preserved. Canonical bd init made setup commit b89b770; subsequent code/docs changes and the passive issue export are uncommitted. No git or Dolt remote push performed.

title: Reconcile RFCs, quickstart and docs with the implemented commerce contract
description:
## Description

README, roadmap and progress disagree on routes, auth, custody readiness, events and finished milestones. Preserve accepted framing and record revised decisions rather than perpetuating competing truth sources.

## Acceptance Criteria

Update published API examples, RFCs and deployment quickstart to the final SDK/HTTP behavior. Document honest receiving/settlement/delivery guarantees and explicit non-custodial capabilities. Beads is the task source; progress only points to active scope. Do not claim unimplemented sweep/recovery or obsolete release prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: Update published API examples, RFCs and deployment quickstart to the final SDK/HTTP behavior. Document honest receiving/settlement/delivery guarantees and explicit non-custodial capabilities. Beads is the task source; progress only points to active scope. Do not claim unimplemented sweep/recovery or obsolete release prerequisites.

title: Remove prototype invoice adapters after the canonical transactional path lands
description:
## Description

Runtime still converts LegacyInvoice/Payment and metadata alongside canonical v2 storage, duplicating shapes and obscuring transaction ownership. Backwards compatibility is explicitly unnecessary.

## Acceptance Criteria

Invoice/deposit processing uses canonical resource/store contracts directly, with no legacy round-trip or hidden metadata state. Delete dead adapters/types/tests and update bootstrap. Retain actual persistence/recovery semantics through the transaction seam.
acceptance_criteria: Invoice/deposit processing uses canonical resource/store contracts directly, with no legacy round-trip or hidden metadata state. Delete dead adapters/types/tests and update bootstrap. Retain actual persistence/recovery semantics through the transaction seam.

title: Verify pinned OWS packaging and correct stale custody prerequisites
description:
## Description

Runtime already pins OWS 56184be with indexed derivation/signing; nano-core 3.5 includes state-block signing codecs. README claims both still await coordinated releases. OWS default main is older than this pinned branch.

## Acceptance Criteria

A clean supported deployment resolves/builds the pinned binding and passes derive/sign readiness without sibling source links. Document native/platform requirements and actual compatible versions. Preserve key isolation. Do not replace the required fork revision blindly with default upstream main.
acceptance_criteria: A clean supported deployment resolves/builds the pinned binding and passes derive/sign readiness without sibling source links. Document native/platform requirements and actual compatible versions. Preserve key isolation. Do not replace the required fork revision blindly with default upstream main.

title: Consolidate RPC authentication and provider adaptation behind nano-core
description:
## Description

RPC wrapper reaches into endpoint pool internals and recreates fetch/auth. Startup probes separately map URL userinfo to Basic auth, conflicting with ORIS-010 Bearer shorthand. Watcher uses another transport path.

## Acceptance Criteria

Use supported nano-core transport seams for RPC, probes, observation and work. Separate endpoint and key, normalize permitted credential URL shorthand to Bearer, redact credentials and consistently handle rate limits/unsupported provider actions. Keep durable observation/business orchestration in RaiFlow. Gateway JSON-RPC2/SSE remains optional and requires an explicit adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Use supported nano-core transport seams for RPC, probes, observation and work. Separate endpoint and key, normalize permitted credential URL shorthand to Bearer, redact credentials and consistently handle rate limits/unsupported provider actions. Keep durable observation/business orchestration in RaiFlow. Gateway JSON-RPC2/SSE remains optional and requires an explicit adapter.

title: Upgrade nano-core and nano-rspow to the current compatible releases
description:
## Description

Root pnpm override pins nano-core 3.5.0 and lockfile resolves nano-rspow-node 0.17.1. Published current versions verified 2026-10-20 are nano-core 3.6.0 and nano-rspow-node 0.17.2; canonical PoW vocabulary is in nano-pow-contract 0.2.0. Browser changes in rspow do not fix runtime funds safety.

## Acceptance Criteria

Update actual overrides/manifests/lockfile, not only caret ranges. Confirm public block/work APIs and native runtime compatibility with the pinned OWS dependency. Keep maintenance changes reviewable separately from orchestration changes and do not promise browser performance gains on the server.
acceptance_criteria: Update actual overrides/manifests/lockfile, not only caret ranges. Confirm public block/work APIs and native runtime compatibility with the pinned OWS dependency. Keep maintenance changes reviewable separately from orchestration changes and do not promise browser performance gains on the server.

title: Provide explicit refund linkage and require a verified destination
description:
## Description

Refunds and overpayment disposition are ordinary commerce concerns. The incoming sender can be an exchange hot wallet and must not become an automatic refund address.

## Acceptance Criteria

Represent a refund against its deposit/invoice using the existing durable send machinery. Require an explicit application-verified destination and idempotency key; never default to incoming source. Track refunded amounts/outcomes and reject conflicting or excessive refunds. Keep identity verification policy in the application.
acceptance_criteria: Represent a refund against its deposit/invoice using the existing durable send machinery. Require an explicit application-verified destination and idempotency key; never default to incoming source. Track refunded amounts/outcomes and reject conflicting or excessive refunds. Keep identity verification policy in the application.
